from config_service import _GLOBAL_CONFIG_CACHE, get_active_config, reset_config


@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def clean_config_state():
    """Reset configuration cache before and after each test."""
    reset_config()
    yield
    reset_config()


def test_a_default_tenant_config():
    config = get_active_config()
    assert config["region"] == "us-east-1", f"Expected us-east-1, got {config['region']}"


def test_b_mutate_tenant_config():
    _GLOBAL_CONFIG_CACHE["region"] = "eu-central-1"
    assert get_active_config()["region"] == "eu-central-1"

leaderboard.nemotron_rationale: Executing mutating sibling tests twice before target test triggers order pollution and leftover state.
Permuting sibling test execution order exposes missing fixture cleanup.
Reversing sibling test order exposes sequential test dependencies.
CPU contention widens the window for dirty state reads between test cases.
